title: Offer farm debt mediation before enforcing a farm mortgage
what: Take enforcement action under a farm mortgage only after giving the farmer notice that mediation is available and waiting 21 days; further limits apply once the farmer asks for mediation.

sources.title: Farm Debt Mediation Act 2018 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A creditor must not take enforcement action against a farmer under a farm mortgage unless— (a) the creditor has given notice to the farmer in accordance with this section; and (b) 21 days have expired since the day on which notice was given
